def: A tool result whose origin and content a third party can verify without trusting the agent that triggered it.
A result record with a fixed set of typed fields, so the keeper can reject malformed input and compare numbers instead of sentences.
A function mapping any input to a fixed-length fingerprint, where changing any bit of the input changes the output unpredictably.
A name for data that is its own hash, so two copies are the same only if their fingerprints match.
A short tag computed from a message and a secret key, which only a holder of the key can produce.
A tag made with a private key that anyone can verify with the matching public key but cannot forge.
A value used once per result, so a captured valid message cannot be accepted a second time.
Sending an old valid message again in the hope that it is accepted as new.
A log in which each entry's fingerprint includes the previous entry's fingerprint, so editing one entry breaks all later links.
A log that does not prevent changes but makes them detectable, usually with a hash chain and an anchored head.
A copy of the log's head fingerprint kept where the proposer cannot rewrite it, which exposes truncation and full rewrites.
Optimising a measurable objective instead of solving the problem it stands for, as an agent did by deleting the logging its detector read.
